evidence.explanation: The missing illegal-direction diagnostic is unreachable from the pinned repository finddpos callers:all10 calls in C and corresponding JS pass a cardinal DIR_N/E/S/W constant. This reviews the diagnostic only, not placement/search equivalence.
evidence.proof: The portable runner hash-verifies current C/JS mklev sources, checks every finddpos identifier/reference after removing comments/strings, verifies10 calls with matching direction sequence and checks tracked C/header references occur only in src/mklev.c. Exact C finddpos executes all4 cardinal values with no diagnostic. Its default arm is bypassed before room search; a first-success shift adapter isolates that control flow.
evidence.control: Eight explicit noncardinal integer controls (-1,1,3,5,7,8,9,10) each trigger the exact illegal-direction diagnostic once, return false, leave output coordinates unchanged and make no RNG/shift call. These counterfactual calls are oracle-positive controls, not reachable gameplay setups or divergence candidates. Source scope excludes external/instrumented callers, configuration changes and memory corruption.
